stemMd: Choose the verb form that completes the sentence: "The guide has ___ this trail many times."
explanationMd: The auxiliary has forms the present perfect with a past participle. For take, that participle is "taken."

distractorRationale.d: The perfect auxiliary has cannot directly take this present participle here.
distractorRationale.c: The base form does not complete the present perfect.
distractorRationale.a: Has requires the past participle, not the simple past.
